Going through the reviews which were hardly any for this outlet so I had to resort to the reviews of the second outlet to know what's their famous option. I found out many reviewers had recommended pizza dosa and jini dosa. Sadly the pizza dosa was missing in this outlet's menu however we still asked for it . The cook was courteous enough to serve us the pizza dosa which was great loaded with cheese and ofcourse the veggies. featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are a Pav Bhaji lover, Pav Bhaji Klub Invite is a place you should definitely try. This place is known for serving a wide variety of Pav Bhaji options, and their menu is quite unique compared to regular places. From classic Pav Bhaji to smoked Pav Bhaji, cheese-loaded versions, and even fusion items like Pizza Lasagna, they have something different to offer.

One of the most interesting things about this place is how they experiment with flavors while still keeping the authentic Pav Bhaji taste intact. The smoked Pav Bhaji is a must-try because it has a rich, smoky flavor and tastes amazing with their buttery pav. Their Pizza Lasagna is also very different and perfect for people who like trying fusion dishes.

The ambience is casual and comfortable, making it a good place to hang out with friends and family. The service is quick, and the staff is friendly and helpful with recommendations.

Overall, Pav Bhaji Klub Invite is a great spot for comfort food lovers, especially if you enjoy different varieties of Pav Bhaji. The food is flavorful, the portions are good, and the menu is unique, which makes the place worth visiting.

featured_reviews.name: Sweet Sour
featured_reviews.review_text:
Finally visited that restaurant in Borivali — the one everyone keeps raving about — and honestly, now I get the hype ✨

Started off on a refreshing note with their Pink Guava and Lemonana drinks. The pink guava was nostalgic and perfectly sweet-tangy, while the lemonana was super zesty and cooling, exactly what you want to kickstart a meal.

For starters, we tried the Hara Bhara Kebab — crisp on the outside, soft and flavourful inside — and the Peri Peri Fried (spicy, crunchy, and absolutely addictive). Both were solid winners and set the mood just right.

The mains were a delicious mix of comfort and indulgence. The Dragon Noodles were smoky, spicy, and loaded with flavour, while the Neer Dosa was soft, light, and beautifully balanced the boldness of the noodles.

Ended the meal on a sweet high with Kulfi Falooda — rich, creamy, and generously layered. The perfect dessert to wrap up an already satisfying experience. 🍨

Overall, great food, comforting flavours, and totally worth the buzz. Definitely a place I’d go back to when cravings hit 😌🍽️

Wanna hang out with family in Borivali West? Achija is a great choice!

Achija is a pure veg restaurant located near Borivali station on Chandavarkar Road, right next to Ghantawala Pan.

🏠 Ambience:

At the entrance, there is a waiting area, and while you wait, you can enjoy pani puri from the outlet outside. The restaurant has two floors – the ground floor is small, but the first floor is spacious. Evenings are crowded, so expect a 15-30 minute wait.

🏃‍♂️ Service:

The service was quick and efficient.

What we ordered:

🆓 Complementary: 1-liter packaged water and 2 papads.

🍹 Drinks:

▶ Pineapple Juice – Fresh and nice, we asked for it without ice and sugar.
▶ Orange Juice – My daughter loved it! All seasonal juices were fresh.

🍲 Starters:

▶ Pani Puri – 8 pieces per plate, the highest I've seen! Tasty and customizable as per your preference.

🍱 Main Course:

▶ Lasagne – Super cheesy and delicious, loaded with veggies and paneer chunks. It was made in white sauce, which I preferred over red sauce. Felt like an Indian version of lasagne, but it was tasty!
▶ Onion Rawa Masala Dosa – Dosa was good, but the masala was bland. Sambhar and chutney were just okay.

🍰 Desserts:

▶ We were too full to order desserts!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Ma Anjani Pav Bhaji at Korakendra, Borivali, and it turned out to be a delightful experience for any true pav bhaji lover.

I tried their much-talked-about 3-in-1 Pav Bhaji platter, which is a unique and satisfying combination of Black, Red, and Green Bhaji, served with generously sized soft pav, refreshing buttermilk, and a fresh onion-tomato salad on the side. The portion size is impressive, and considering the variety offered, it feels like great value for money.

What truly stood out for me was the Kothmir (daniya) Pav — easily one of the most flavorful. Rich in taste, perfectly balanced, and something I would happily go back for again.

If you’re in Borivali, this place deserves a visit.

Highly recommended for pav bhaji lovers looking to try something beyond the ordinary.

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Aundhakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Ma Anjani Pav Bhaji at Korakendra, Borivali and tried their famous 3-in-1 Pav Bhaji, and it was a really satisfying experience. This combo includes three different bhajis – Black, Red and Green, served with big, soft 3 pav pieces, fried papad, buttermilk, and a fresh onion-tomato salad. The total cost was around ₹400, which felt reasonable considering the quantity and variety.
Among the three, I absolutely loved the Black Pav Bhaji – it was rich, flavourful, slightly smoky and very different from the regular pav bhaji you get everywhere. The Red bhaji was nicely spicy and the Green one was fresh and herby, giving a nice balance to the plate.
I also tried the Masala Khichiya Papad, which was topped with fresh chopped onions, tomatoes and masala. It was very crisp, fresh and perfectly seasoned – a great starter.
The overall presentation, freshness and taste were really good. Everything felt hygienic and well-prepared. The combination of pav bhaji with buttermilk and salad makes the meal feel complete and not too heavy.
If you’re in Borivali and want to try something different from regular pav bhaji, this place is definitely worth visiting.
Highly recommended for pav bhaji lovers, especially for the Black Pav Bhaji 👍

featured_reviews.name: Hritik Nilesh Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tried dinner at Good Flippin’ Burger with my cousin.

The burgers were genuinely amazing — juicy, flavorful, and definitely the highlight of the meal. However, the overall experience wasn’t as smooth. There was quite a long wait just to place the order, followed by another long wait for the food to be prepared.

Seating is also a challenge. The outlet is quite small with very limited space inside. They do have some seating on the street, but it was already full when we visited, so we had to wait for that as well.

Fries were average — nothing special compared to the burgers.

Overall: great burgers, but be prepared for waiting and limited seating, especially during peak hours.

featured_reviews.name: Sanika Kashikar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Flippin Burger at I.C. Colony, Borivali, is definitely a spot worth trying if you’re a burger lover looking for a quick indulgence. The place has a simple, casual vibe, perfect for hanging out with friends or grabbing a meal on the go. Their burgers are well-prepared, with soft buns, fresh toppings, and flavorful patties that feel quite satisfying. The seasoning and balance of sauces work really well, giving each bite a nice mix of taste and texture.

What stands out is the freshness of ingredients and the fact that they don’t compromise on the taste. Whether you go for a chicken, beef, or vegetarian option, the overall quality remains consistent. The portion sizes are decent enough to fill you up, and the presentation adds a nice touch to the experience.

The only area where Flippin Burger could improve is the pricing. While the burgers are tasty and enjoyable, the cost feels a bit on the higher side compared to other similar eateries in the area. A slight reduction in price would definitely make it more pocket-friendly and appealing for regular visits.

All in all, it’s a great burger joint with good taste, freshness, and quality—just a tad overpriced.
